indications_and_usage: Use(s) For the temporary relief of pain associated with • Minor burns • Sunburn
warnings: Warnings For External Use Only. Do not use • On wounds or damaged skin • In large quantities, particularly over raw surfaces or blistered areas When using this product • Avoid contact with the eyes • Do not bandage tightly Stop use and ask a doctor if • Condition worsens • Symptoms persist for more than 7 days • Symptoms clear up and occur again within a few days Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center (1-800-222-1222) right away.
do_not_use: Do not use • On wounds or damaged skin • In large quantities, particularly over raw surfaces or blistered areas
when_using: When using this product • Avoid contact with the eyes • Do not bandage tightly
stop_use: Stop use and ask a doctor if • Condition worsens • Symptoms persist for more than 7 days • Symptoms clear up and occur again within a few days
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center (1-800-222-1222) right away.
dosage_and_administration: Directions • Adults and children 2 years of age and older: Apply to affected area not more than 3 to 4 times daily. • Children under 2 years of age: Consult a doctor
other_safety_information: Other Information • Store at room temperature
